verdict.rationale: Otter's first-party materials say you can record conversations directly from the Mac or Windows desktop app without bots joining the call. They also describe bot-free recording through the desktop app and bot-free capture of impromptu Google Meet calls. Community complaints about the Otter bot joining calls concern the separate scheduled-notetaker mode, so they do not contradict the bot-free desktop capture claim. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how device-side audio capture works, explicit confirmation that external participants receive no notification or summary email in bot-free mode, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bot-free recording.
